label: GMAW · mild steel · 6 mm fillet
notes: Spray transfer with 1.2 mm wire, for the gun this cell actually has. Stickout is 17 mm, the cell's one default standoff (owner, 2026-09-11), and that is the number to read first: the tube baked into link_6 is Ø32 all the way to the tip, and the flat-plate estimate at a 45 degree work angle asks for something over 20 mm. Through the motion planner on bracket_b_2x, 17 mm and 22 mm crossed the same 8 of 22 seams, and 17 sits inside what that gun is held at (15-30 mm). The current is 255 A, set when this preset held the gun at 22 mm: a shorter electrode is less resistive preheat, so the same wire feed at 17 mm draws more current than that -- the arc numbers are unverified at 17 until they are welded. One pass carries a 6 mm leg comfortably; above about 8 mm this wants splitting into root and cap rather than slowing the travel down.
